verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox (CMRA) service, so guided USPS Form 1583 completion is an applicable axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Form 1583, pre-filled forms, online notarization, or ID requirements. The closest items cover business-address registration suitability and help articles on adding recipients or transferring centers, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete USPS Form 1583 with guided help — pre-filled forms, online notarization, and clear ID requirements — instead of deciphering the CMRA process alone
